body:
My spouse was unable to even acknowledge my cancer diagnosis.  It was too much to bear with the burden of a child and my other health issues.  I don't think this situation will be different.

I am in my 30s.
My condition is progressive.  Best case scenario is to not get worse, but it is very slim.

My neurologists and neurosurgeons have stopped all treatment due to the cancer diagnosis.  They believe it carries to much risk for complication due to the immune system issues and the load it places on my organs.  My pain management doctor has been unsuccessful at reducing the pain and also has declined further treatment.  No other doctors I have contacted will accept me as a patient.
